nyn: Tikirahamibwa. Ikiriza obutumwa bw'okushashura aha simu yaawe, bwanyima ogarukyemu okande Hamya.

lg: Ekisumuluzo kyo eky'okusuubula ye nnamba 6 z'okozesa okukakasa okuggyamu ssente n'ebirala ebikulu.

rw: Ijambobanga ryawe ry'ubucuruzi ni PIN y'imibare 6 ukoresha wemeza kubikuza n'ibindi bikorwa by'ingenzi.
nyn: Ekisumuruzo kyaawe ky'okushuubura n'enamba 6 ezi orikukozesa okuhamya okwihamu sente n'ebindi ebikuru.

lg: Weetaaga koodi y'okuyita okwewandiisa. Saba oyo eyakuyise akuwe eyiye.

en: Please fill in your payment account accurately, incorrect filling may result in the loss of the transferred funds.

rw: Nyamuneka andika konti yawe yo kwishyura neza; ukosheje ushobora gutakaza amafaranga wohereje.
nyn: Handiika akaunti yaawe y'okushashura gye; ku orikuhandiika kubi noobaasa kufeerwa sente ezi ohereize.

en: Please fill in your payment method and the actual payment account you will use to make the payment.

rw: Nyamuneka andika uburyo bwo kwishyura na konti nyayo uzakoresha wishyura.
nyn: Handiika omuringo gw'okushashura n'akaunti ey'amazima ei orikwija kukozesa okushashura.

sw: Bandika ujumbe wote wa uthibitisho uliopokelewa kwenye simu yako baada ya kutuma pesa. Timu yetu itauangalia na kuongeza salio lako.

rw: Shyiramo ubutumwa bwose bwo kwemeza telefone yawe yakiriye nyuma yo kohereza amafaranga. Ikipe yacu irabusuzuma maze ikongera amafaranga yawe.
nyn: Ota obutumwa bwona obw'okuhamya obu esimu yaawe eyakiire bwanyima y'okutuma sente. Ekibiina kyaitu nikibureeba kandi bakakwongyeza sente.
